The document **“imdb_top_1000.csv”** has the most embedding chunks, with **586 chunks**.

```json
{
  "question": "Which document has the most embedding chunks, and how many chunks does it have?",
  "sql": "SELECT d.name, COUNT(e.id) AS chunk_count\nFROM documents d\nJOIN embeddings e ON d.id = e.document_id\nGROUP BY d.id, d.name\nORDER BY chunk_count DESC\nLIMIT 1;",
  "row_count": 1,
  "answer": "The document \"imdb_top_1000.csv\" has the most embedding chunks, with 586 chunks."
}
```
